question: Select the CORRECT combination of novelist and their works.

options.text: The Cat and Shakespeare – Ravindranath Tagore
Two Leaves and a Bud – Mulk Raj Anand
The Chess Master and His Moves – RK Narayan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Two Leaves and a Bud – Mulk Raj Anand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Two Leaves and a Bud – Mulk Raj Anand**
 
• **This pair is Correct**
 
 
• Two Leaves and a Bud is a f**amous work by Mulk Raj Anand, an Indian writer known for addressing social issues like caste discrimination and exploitation. **
 
• Th**is novel portrays the exploitation of Indian workers in British tea plantations.**
 
• It was **Published in 1937**
 
• The novel is set against the backdrop of British colonial rule in India, specifically focusing on the **exploitative practices in British-owned tea plantations in Assam**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Cat and Shakespeare – Ravindranath Tagore**
 
• **This pair is Incorrect**
 
 
• The **Cat and Shakespeare is a philosophical novel written by Raja Rao, not Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• Raja Rao is one of India's prominent English-language novelists.
 
 
 
• **Waiting for Mahatma – Raja Rao**
 
• This pair is Incorrect
 
 
• Waiting for Mahatma** is written by R. K. Narayan, one of India’s most beloved English-language authors.**
 
• The novel humorously and poignantly explores the influence of Gandhi on an ordinary Indian youth's life.
 
 
 
• **The Chess Master and His Moves – R. K. Narayan**
 
• This pair is Incorrect
 
 
• The Chess Master **and His Moves is written by Raja Rao, not R. K. Narayan. **
 
• **It is a complex philosophical novel exploring Indian spiritualism and European rationalism**.
